result:
This hour's foreman run is done. All 5 FEBio runs are healthy, nothing is hung or out of memory, and all 10 tmux services are up.

**Inventory (17:51–18:00)**
- **CPU:** 24.2–25.0 of the 32-core quota busy, with no throttling. The machine's load is 248 on 256 cores, almost all from other users.
- **Memory:** 126.5 of 137.4 GB used; only 16.4 GB of that is program memory (the rest is file cache). No out-of-memory kills.
- **GPUs:** my runs use 1–6 GB each on GPUs 1–4, at 0–9% utilisation (FEBio is limited by CPU, not GPU). GPUs 5–6 are full with other users' jobs.
- **Queues:** the h19 and evo queues are empty.
  - physio_relG: 8 of 27 designs done, 3 of them in the last hour (p074, p064, p068). 5 running (p071, p082, p083, p084, p088), 14 waiting. At about 95 min per run, the set should finish around 00:30.
  - physio_relG_pl: 10 fallback windows are queued and start only once physio_relG is finished. That is how it was set up. `ops/resume_all.sh` covers it, so a restart won't lose it.

**Health**
- Between 17:07 and 17:18, h50 skipped 10 designs because their h24 preflight wasn't ready yet; they are simply retried later.
- p083 failed on launch (exit 3) three times between 17:19 and 17:29, then started at 17:34 and is running. There is no crash loop now.

**Action**
- 4 of the 5 runs had their 6 cores split across two NUMA nodes (memory regions), and node 1 had threads from all 5 runs. I re-pinned each of the 4 to idle cores in the node next to its GPU:
  - p084 → 112-117 and p082 → 121-126 (node 7, GPU 4)
  - p071 → 48-53 (node 3, GPU 1)
  - p088 → 20,26,28-31 (node 1, GPU 2)
- There is no speed gain yet. Two minutes later, CPU per run read 462–501% against 487–508% before the move, which may just be memory pages migrating to the new node. I recorded the current steps per minute (p084 4, p082 3, p083 5, p071 5, p088 12) so next hour can show whether it helped; if it didn't, I'll put the old pins back.

**Still idle:** about 7 quota cores and most GPU capacity. A 6th 6-core run was tried at 16:03 and got throttled, so using this needs 5-core runs. That is a setting in h50/h18, which is the owner's decision.

**Needs a person (unchanged)**
- Leave the `*_gpu5` run directories (launcher failures) out of the physio_relG read-outs.
- h50 retries a failed launch every 10 min with no limit; it needs a cap.
- h18 should pick cores within the GPU's own NUMA node, without overlapping other runs.

The full report is in `work/agents/foreman/report_20261110_1751.md`. I also updated `status.json` and added two lines to `work/ops/foreman_actions.log`.
